title: Individual integral projection and refinement maps in simultaneous-system coordinates
statement:
Fix a finite-field datum $D$, its coefficient datum $C$ with prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a positive finite level, and a normalized six-functor operation datum $S$ [def-fix-six-functor-datum]. Assume $\ell$ is invertible in the base field. Fix simultaneous-system operations $o$ and their canonical realization data $z$ [def-sf-integral-system-operations, lem-sf-integral-compactification-system-realization]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a separated finite-type morphism of finite-type schemes over the base field, $K\in D^b_c(X,\mathcal O_E)$ and $L\in D^b_c(Y,\mathcal O_E)$, with $L$ in the uniform finite-reduction Tor domain [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. Write $M=\mathcal R_XK$, $N=\mathcal R_YL$, $T=M\otimes P_fN$ and $\mathcal L_Y=R\lim\operatorname{Res}$. For every compactification $c=(j_c,p_c)$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements] put $U_c=(S_{p_c}J_{j_c}M)\otimes N$, $V_c=S_{p_c}J_{j_c}T$, $A_c=(S_{\rm int}(f,c)K)\widehat\otimes L$ and $B_c=S_{\rm int}(f,c)(K\widehat\otimes P_{f,\rm int}L)$. There exist simultaneously isomorphisms $\alpha_c:\mathcal L_YU_c\cong A_c$ and $\beta_c:\mathcal L_YV_c\cong B_c$ with these individual-arrow identities (composition is right to left):
$$\beta_c\,\mathcal L_Y(\operatorname{PF}^{\rm sys}_c)=\operatorname{PF}^{S}_c\,\alpha_c.$$
For every proper refinement $r:c\to d$, let $q_r$ be the specified directed system comparison of [lem-sf-refinement-projection-counit] and $\rho_{c,d}$ the operation datum compactification comparison. Then
$$\beta_c\,\mathcal L_Y(q_r(T))=\rho_{c,d}(K\widehat\otimes P_fL)^{-1}\,\beta_d,$$
$$\alpha_c\,\mathcal L_Y(q_r(M)\otimes1_N)=(\rho_{c,d}(K)^{-1}\widehat\otimes1_L)\,\alpha_d.$$
The integral arrows are read in the ambient derived category through its full-subcategory inclusion. No equality of the two projection/refinement routes is assumed or asserted.

theorem integralProjectionSystemCoordinates
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (C : D.CoefficientDatum)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic C.l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic C.l) E] (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (S : SixFunctorOperationDatum D C E n hn) (hl : IsUnit (C.l : D.k))
    (o : Operations C.l E) (z : Realizations C.l E D o)
    {X Y : SixFunctorSpace D} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsSeparated f.hom.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType f.hom.left] [QuasiCompact f.hom.left]
    (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory C.l E X.obj.left)
    (L : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory C.l E Y.obj.left)
    (hL : finiteTorConstructibleIntegral C.l E Y.obj.left L.obj) :
    let M := (calculus C.l E X.obj.left).reduction.obj K.obj
    let N := (calculus C.l E Y.obj.left).reduction.obj L.obj
    let T := (calculus C.l E X.obj.left).systemClosed.tensor.obj
      (M, (pull C.l E f.hom.left).obj N)
    let F := (sfIntegralConstructible C.l E Y.obj.left).ι
    let R := coefficientSequenceLimit C.l E Y.obj.left
    let U := fun c : Compactification f.hom.left ↦
      (calculus C.l E Y.obj.left).systemClosed.tensor.obj
        ((Operations.push C.l E o c.g).obj ((Operations.shriek C.l E o c.i).obj M), N)
    let V := fun c : Compactification f.hom.left ↦
      (Operations.push C.l E o c.g).obj ((Operations.shriek C.l E o c.i).obj T)
    let A := fun c : Compactification f.hom.left ↦
      ((S.higher.integralTensor Y).obj ((S.higher.integral.support f c).obj K)).obj L
    let B := fun c : Compactification f.hom.left ↦
      (S.higher.integral.support f c).obj
        (((S.higher.integralTensor X).obj K).obj ((S.higher.integral.pull f).obj L))
    ∃ (alpha : ∀ c, R.obj (U c) ≅ F.obj (A c))
      (beta : ∀ c, R.obj (V c) ≅ F.obj (B c)),
      (∀ c, R.map (compactificationProjection C.l E o z.compositors z.openComparisons c M N) ≫
          (beta c).hom = (alpha c).hom ≫
            F.map ((S.higher.integralExchange (identitySquare f c)).projectionComponent K L)) ∧
      (∀ (c d : Compactification f.hom.left) (r : c.Refinement d),
        R.map (RefinementProjection.systemComparison C.l E D o z r T) ≫ (beta c).hom =
          (beta d).hom ≫ F.map ((S.higher.integral.comparison f c d).inv.app
            (((S.higher.integralTensor X).obj K).obj ((S.higher.integral.pull f).obj L))) ∧
        R.map ((calculus C.l E Y.obj.left).systemClosed.tensor.map
          (Prod.mkHom (RefinementProjection.systemComparison C.l E D o z r M) (𝟙 N))) ≫
            (alpha c).hom = (alpha d).hom ≫
              F.map (((S.higher.integralTensor Y).map
                ((S.higher.integral.comparison f c d).inv.app K)).app L))
